newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower on selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower on selling pressure.

text.p: Dhaka shares tumbled nearly three percent after a selling pressure from retail investors pulled down prices of most traded issues, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index lost 74.37 points or 2.79 percent at 2,587.24 on a turnover of 77 million taka. Of 99 issues traded, 79 lost and 21 gained.

"Small investors still cannot put faith in the market. Moreover, fund crisis prevails despite restrictions lifted from bank credit. Banks are reluctant to give credit ahead of year end," said one broker. Beximco Pharma lost 15.15 taka to 288.43 and Monno Fabrics shed 13.37 to 254.09.
